name: oc_mika_destruction

blogTitle: PROOF that SOMEONE (u know who u are) TRACED mika destruction. side by side. w/ overlay. w/ ARROWS
about: im mika (the artist) n Mika Destruction is my OC (the character) n yes we have the same name, she came first, i changed mine. shes a 17 yr old half-demon w/ green hair n a scythe that turns into a guitar n she has a 40 page backstory on my dA. i draw every day, i post every day, i have a wacom graphire n a tablet callus. SOMEONE on dA traced her n changed the hair to blue n called her 'Miko Destruction' n i have the overlay to prove it. usagi-chan is my best friend n she has seen the overlay.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: hiromu arakawa. CLAMP. and the person who traced my OC, in person, w/ my overlay printed out on a poster board.

interests.General: drawing my OC, drawing OTHER ppls OCs (for art trades ONLY, not for free, dont ask), deviantART, my wacom, copic markers (i have 6, theyre 7 dollars each), anime club w/ usagi, oekaki boards, making collages of my OC in photoshop 7, tracing detection

bulletins.subject: PROOF. side by side. w/ overlay. w/ arrows. (repost if u believe in ORIGINAL ART)
bulletins.body: ok. left: Mika Destruction, my OC, drawn by ME on march 3 (the file date is on it). right: 'Miko Destruction' posted on dA 2 weeks ago by SOMEONE. same pose. same hands (wrong the same way). same scythe but they made it a sword bc they couldnt figure out the guitar part. hair is blue instead of green. thats it. thats the difference. i made an overlay in photoshop 7 n set the top layer to 50% n it is 94% the same. usagi-chan checked. sephiroth checked. im not saying the name. everyone knows the name. repost this if u think ppl should draw their own stuff. or dont. but they traced her.
